source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"job","sql":"SELECT job_no FROM emc_job_order WHERE job_no = ?","params":["${input.jobNo}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"job","error_code":"JOB_NOT_FOUND","error_message":"Job order not found"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"dt","sql":"SELECT defect_type_id FROM emc_defect_type WHERE defect_type_id = ?","params":["${input.defectTypeId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"dt","error_code":"DEFECT_TYPE_UNKNOWN","error_message":"Defect type not found"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"dup","sql":"SELECT defect_no FROM emc_defect_record WHERE defect_no = ?","params":["${input.defectNo}"]},{"type":"when","then":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"DUPLICATE_DEFECT","error_message":"Defect number already registered","defectNo":"${input.defectNo}","status":""}}],"var":"dup","notNull":true},{"type":"exec","sql":"@file:emc_qa_registerDefect-step.sql","params":["${input.defectNo}","${input.jobNo}","${input.lotId}","${input.defectTypeId}","${input.reasonCode}","${input.severity}","${input.qtyDeclared}","${input.createdBy}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"@file:emc_qa_registerDefect-step.sql","params":["${input.defectNo}","${input.createdBy}"]},{"type":"when","then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE emc_material_lot SET status = 'BLOCKED_QC' WHERE lot_id = NULLIF(?, '') AND status = 'STOCK'","params":["${input.lotId}"]}],"var":"input.severity","equals":"CRITICAL"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","defectNo":"${input.defectNo}","status":"REGISTERED"}}]}
